facts.fact: Decree no. 2024-0300/PT-RM of 14 May 2024 sets the fees payable to the APDP: 100,000 F CFA per declaration and 200,000 per authorisation for legal persons, 25,000 and 50,000 for individuals, and 2,000,000 for certification and 10,000,000 for approval of certification bodies; non-profit public services are exempt.
The decree is made under Law no. 2013-015 of 21 May 2013, as amended, on protection of personal data in Mali, and applies it (decree of 14 May 2024).
The decree provides that fees are paid to the APDP's revenue office (régie de recettes), which implies a constituted authority operating (decree of 14 May 2024).
